algorithm_title: Develop a process for multiplying 2 matrices
evidence_summary: This suite provides partial behavioural evidence using 3 predefined common behavioural tests, with covered state-mutation behaviour. Matrix dimensions and values are internally random; fixed seeds make the generated compatible matrices reproducible.
coverage_basis: Assessment is based on the 3 predefined common behavioural tests, the behaviours exposed by the frozen program interface, and the declared coverage dimensions: state mutation.
interpretation_guidance: Interpret behavioural accuracy as useful but incomplete evidence across the declared exercised behaviours; unexercised behaviours remain outside the direct evidence.
coverage_limitations: Matrix dimensions and values are internally random; fixed seeds make the generated compatible matrices reproducible.
